units.source_text: 不知什么时候开始，我竟随狗走了起来。

en.t: Before I knew when it had begun, I found myself walking after the dog.
The dog kept appearing and disappearing from sight.

units.source_text: 在通往河原町的路上拐了弯。

en.t: It turned a corner on the road leading to Kawaramachi.

units.source_text: 我就这样来到了比新京极还黑暗的电车路旁的人行道上。

en.t: In this way I came to the sidewalk beside the tram road, darker even than Shinkyogoku.
The dog had vanished without a trace.

units.source_text: 我停下脚步，左顾右盼，甚至走到电车路的边上，探寻狗的踪迹。

en.t: I stopped, looked left and right, and even went to the edge of the tram road, searching for traces of the dog.
